# Vendored libraries

Loaded only when needed: the geometry libraries for Cut out, gaps, lines and Fit (`static/geometry.js`, as
`/assets/geometry.js`), and SVGO for Optimize.
Copied by `scripts/vendor-geometry.sh` from the versions pinned in `tests/js/package.json`.

## inter-latin-400.woff — Inter (from @fontsource/inter 5.3.0)

Copyright (c) 2016 The Inter Project Authors. SIL Open Font License 1.1: https://openfontlicense.org.
The fallback font for turning text into shapes when no other font is chosen.
